---
title: "About"
---

A map of the trails in [Pacific Spirit Regional Park](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-parks/park/pacific-spirit-regional-park)
(Vancouver, BC) and the streets around it, built for a running group. It's the
first step towards generating routes: turning written directions into GPX and
back, making loops or point-to-point runs of a given distance, and one day
covering every trail in the park with as little backtracking as possible.

## Reading the map

- **Park trails** are coloured by bike access, the same split as the official
  park map: <span style="color:#2a78d6">■</span> shared,
  <span style="color:#eb6834">■</span> hiking only,
  <span style="color:#1baf7a">■</span> not tagged either way.
- Grey lines are streets, sidewalks and paths outside the park. We use them
  sparingly, only to link trails without doubling back.
- <span style="color:#eda100">●</span> **WC** marks toilets and
  <span style="color:#e87ba4">●</span> **W** drinking water, useful when
  planning long runs and aid stations. They come from OpenStreetMap: check
  opening hours and seasonal closures before race day.
- Hover a line for its name. Click it for its tags and a link to it on
  OpenStreetMap.
- The buttons at the top left turn layers on and off, including what we
  removed from the network (red) and links we added (dotted black).

On a phone, the [full-screen map](trail_map.html) is easier to use.

## Our edits

OpenStreetMap has more than we run and misses a few links we use, so we keep
a small set of [edits](https://github.com/chendaniely/psp-trails/tree/main/data/manual):

- NW and SW Marine Drive are the park's edge for us: beach and foreshore
  trails below them are left out, as are a few dead-end stubs, parking-lot
  spurs and school grounds.
- Where a trail crosses W 16th Avenue but OSM never joined the two sides
  (Cleveland Trail; Sword Fern to Douglas Fir), we add the missing link.
- Every build checks that trails still connect across Chancellor Blvd,
  University Blvd and W 16th Ave.

## Data

| Data | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Trails, streets, toilets, water | [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/11683817) | © OpenStreetMap contributors, [ODbL](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/) |
| Park boundary | [Metro Vancouver open data](https://open-data-portal-metrovancouver.hub.arcgis.com/datasets/regional-parks-boundaries) | Open Government Licence – Metro Vancouver |
| Basemap | [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org/) | © OpenMapTiles, data © OpenStreetMap contributors |

If a public trail is missing or wrong, the best fix is in
[OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/) itself, so every map and app
gets it. The code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/chendaniely/psp-trails).

Please stay on marked trails and follow the park's rules on bikes and dogs.
